meta.description: Replace monolithic plan JSON diagrams with native .mmd/.drawio files in arch/ directory, rendered via mermaid.js and Draw.io viewer, with AI chat review panel

phases.name: Schema & Scaffolding
phases.description: Update plan schema, create arch manifest schema, update setup-feature.py to scaffold arch/ directory.

tasks.name: Update plan-schema.json
tasks.description: Remove required uiFlows, dataModels, dataFlow, services from sections. Add optional architecture object with ref field. Keep implementationPhases required.

tasks.name: Create arch-schema.json
tasks.description: Define JSON schema for _arch.json manifest (feature, diagrams array with name/file/type/diagramType/description).

tasks.name: Update setup-feature.py
tasks.description: Add arch/ directory creation and empty _arch.json scaffolding to feature setup script.

acceptanceCriteria: plan-schema.json validates plans without diagram sections

phases.name: Server API for Architecture Files
phases.description: Add FastAPI routes to serve arch manifest and individual diagram files with path validation.

tasks.name: Create ArchitectureService
tasks.description: New service class with methods to read manifest, validate it, read diagram files, and prevent path traversal.

tasks.name: Create architecture routes
tasks.description: GET /api/projects/{id}/features/{name}/arch (manifest) and GET /api/projects/{id}/features/{name}/arch/{filename} (file content).

tasks.name: Register routes in app.py
tasks.description: Include the new architecture router in the FastAPI app.

acceptanceCriteria: GET /arch/{filename} returns raw file content with correct Content-Type

phases.name: Web App Diagram Rendering
phases.description: Create the architecture page that loads manifest and renders diagrams using mermaid.js and Draw.io viewer.

tasks.name: Create architecture page template
tasks.description: New Jinja2 template for the architecture diagrams page. Includes mermaid.js CDN script, diagram card containers, and loading skeletons.

tasks.name: Create diagram rendering JavaScript
tasks.description: Client-side JS that reads manifest, fetches diagram files, dispatches to type-specific renderers. Renderer map: { mermaid: renderMermaid, drawio: renderDrawio }.

tasks.name: Add architecture page route
tasks.description: GET /project/{id}/arch/{feature_name} page route that serves the template.

tasks.name: Add diagram styles
tasks.description: CSS for diagram cards, loading skeletons, error placeholders, and responsive layout.

acceptanceCriteria: Mermaid .mmd files render as SVG in browser
Draw.io .drawio files render in embedded viewer
Each card shows title and description from manifest
Parse errors show inline with raw source

phases.name: AI Chat Service & API
phases.description: Build the server-side chat service that invokes CLI providers and streams responses via SSE.

tasks.name: Create ChatService
tasks.description: Service that builds prompts from message + diagram context, invokes CLI subprocess, and yields stdout tokens as SSE events.

tasks.name: Create chat routes
tasks.description: POST /api/chat/send accepts { provider, model, message, attachments }, returns SSE stream of response tokens.

tasks.name: Register chat routes in app.py
tasks.description: Include the new chat router in the FastAPI app.

acceptanceCriteria: POST /api/chat/send accepts message with diagram context
Server invokes selected CLI provider subprocess
Response streams as SSE events token-by-token
CLI errors surface as error SSE events

phases.name: Chat Panel Frontend
phases.description: Build the client-side chat UI: toggle button, slide-out panel, provider/model dropdowns, message thread, diagram attachment.

tasks.name: Create chat panel JavaScript
tasks.description: Client-side chat panel component: toggle button, slide-out animation, side-by-side layout reflow, provider/model dropdowns, message input with attachment chips, streaming response rendering.

tasks.name: Add chat panel markup to architecture template
tasks.description: Add chat toggle button, panel container, and split-pane layout wrappers to architecture.html.

tasks.name: Add chat panel styles
tasks.description: CSS for chat panel, slide-out animation, side-by-side layout, message bubbles, attachment chips, streaming text.

tasks.name: Wire diagram click-to-attach
tasks.description: Add click handlers to rendered diagram cards that create attachment chips in the chat input when chat is open.

acceptanceCriteria: Chat button visible bottom-right on architecture page
Panel slides out and page reflows to side-by-side
Provider/model dropdowns load from existing API
Chat thread shows user/AI messages with correct alignment

phases.name: Migration & Cleanup
phases.description: Remove legacy diagram rendering, review system, and template generation. Update plan skill documentation.

tasks.name: Remove legacy SVG template
tasks.description: Delete vista/scripts/visualizer/template.html (1,500+ lines of custom SVG rendering).

tasks.name: Remove review system
tasks.description: Delete review-schema.json, collect-review.py, remove POST /review route from plans.py, remove review methods from progress_service.py.

tasks.name: Update or remove preview.py
tasks.description: Either repurpose preview.py to open the web app URL in browser, or remove entirely.

tasks.name: Remove vista_preview.html
tasks.description: Delete the old Jinja2 template that rendered plan JSON as custom SVG.

tasks.name: Update plan skill documentation
tasks.description: Update SKILL.md Steps 5-7 to generate .mmd files + _arch.json instead of plan JSON diagram sections. Update step 6 to open web app instead of generating preview HTML.

acceptanceCriteria: Plan skill docs describe arch/ generation workflow
